result.reason: The redline properly assigns exclusive ownership of Deliverables to Customer and preserves Vendor ownership of Vendor Technology. However, it does not address Customer ownership of Customer Data, and the embedded Vendor Technology licence is described only by cross-reference as “perpetual”; absent Section 13.2, the required irrevocable and royalty-free rights cannot be confirmed. The margin comment does not cure these omissions in the operative language. The changes are otherwise targeted and professionally drafted.
